ISSUE_KIND: streetlight
ISSUE: Damaged decorative streetlight missing its left lamp housing and globe
DETAILS: The photo shows a historic twin-arm streetlight post backlit by the sun during daylight, missing its lamp fixture/globe on the left arm while exposing the lamp on the right arm. The user note adds no details.
ORGANIZATION: New York City Department of Transportation
DEPARTMENT: Division of Traffic Operations
WHY: West 86th Street is a public municipal roadway in Manhattan, New York City. The New York City Department of Transportation maintains public streetlights throughout the city.
COVERAGE_QUOTE: "NYC DOT maintains nearly 400,000 streetlights throughout New York City, and is a national leader in using sustainable street lighting."
